## Usage

### Installation

Not on PyPI yet. Install:

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/basedtab.git
pip install -e .
```

## How to use

### Load data

`read_csv` and `save_csv`

``` python
from basedtab.core import BFrame

bf = BFrame.read_csv(path)
bf.head(2).df
```

### Groupby

``` python
from basedpl import add, tally, square
MEAN = add.reduce_first / tally
bf.groupby("City", "Income", mean=MEAN)
```

    ┌→─────────────────┐
    ↓"Dallas"⌷         │
    ↓          Income  │
    │mean 45252.23119  │
    │                  │

    │mean 96857.13139  │

    │                  │

    │          Income  │

    │                  │
    │"Boston"⌷         │
    │         Income   │
    │mean 91554.5715   │
    │                  │
    │"Washington D.C."⌷│
    │          Income  │
    │mean 70991.61281  │
    │                  │
    │"San Diego"⌷      │
    │          Income  │
    │mean 100756.2092  │

    │mean 90277.51342  │
    └~─────────────────┘

``` python
RMSE = MEAN.under(square)
bf.groupby("Gender", ["Age", "Income"], mean=MEAN, rmse=RMSE)
```

    ┌→───────────────────────────┐
    ↓"Male"⌷                     │
    ↓             Age      Income│
    │mean  44.9126253  95670.2472│
    │rmse 46.37557969 98752.06754│
    │                            │
    │"Female"⌷                   │
    │             Age      Income│
    │mean 44.99776435 85660.92184│
    │rmse 46.46704189 89097.22374│
    └~───────────────────────────┘

### Rolling

``` python
ts = BFrame(dict(price=[5,4.3,4.1,2,10,20,15,25]))
ts
```

    ┌→────────────────────────────────┐
    │ price:┌→──────────────────────┐ │
    │       │5 4.3 4.1 2 10 20 15 25│ │
    │       └~──────────────────────┘ │
    └∊────────────────────────────────┘

``` python
ts.rolling("price", size=3, edge="clamp", mean=MEAN)
```
